Because the fold is at 45 degrees across a strip of width 4, the diagonal transition consumes 4 units of the original strip length before the remaining part turns upward to form Q. Thus the original length decomposes as x+4+h=13. Rectangle Q has one side equal to the original strip width 4 and the other side h, so area(Q)=4h. Use the text condition P=2Q: 4x=2(4h), so x=2h. Combine with x+h=9 to get h=3 and x=6.

Let the bottom intersection of the 45-degree fold line be at horizontal coordinate x, matching the width of rectangle P shown in the folded diagram.
